card.name: Upper number in a range
card.fires_on: The second number in a range or pair, such as the 4 in "every 3 to 4 weeks" or "two to three times daily". It also fires on the last digit of some numbers like 6.5% or 75%.

modes.label: Upper end of interval
modes.description: The higher number or number word after "to" or "or" in a dosing interval or frequency.

modes.label: Digit inside a value
modes.description: A final digit of a lab value or percentage, often in a range.
